relations.subject: xdcr:reference
relations.evidence: Note in the above example that you need to specify all of the current unchanging configuration parameters also to avoid them being reset to defaults.

relations.subject: xdcr:reference
relations.evidence: Full encryption means that all data and passwords are encrypted which increases security, but reduces overall data transfer speed.

relations.subject: xdcr:reference
relations.evidence: Half encryption means that passwords are encrypted, but data is not. This results in faster data transfer, but less security.

relations.subject: xdcr:reference
relations.evidence: This flag defaults to "none" if it is not specified.

relations.subject: xdcr:reference
relations.evidence:
\--xdcr-hostname-external

Specifies that the hostname passed as `--xdcr-hostname` is an external address.

notable_absence.finding: Again no RBAC role is named for --create/--delete/--edit despite these mutating a cluster-wide reference object. The EXAMPLES section for --create even shows a demand-encryption example using a flag (--xdcr-demand-encryption) that is NOT listed in the SYNOPSIS or OPTIONS sections at all (the documented flag is --xdcr-secure-connection) - a drafting inconsistency inside the page itself, exactly the kind of copy-paste/under-review slip the authorship-provenance hypothesis predicts for a page maintained in the tool's own repo with lighter TW review.

cross_component_finding: The three-way encryption vocabulary here (--xdcr-secure-connection half|full|none) matches the promoted xdcr:half-secure-replication/xdcr:fully-secure-replication concepts built from conceptual docs, so no drift on THIS axis - but the page's own EXAMPLES section uses a flag name (--xdcr-demand-encryption) that appears nowhere in its own SYNOPSIS/OPTIONS, which never mentions --xdcr-secure-connection in that example. That is an internal terminology/flag-name mismatch within a single lightly-reviewed CLI reference page, not a cross-component one - but it is exactly the class of error the round's authorship-provenance axis is watching for.
